question: taxi zones containing point -73.9859, 40.7276
sql: SELECT z.location_id, z.zone FROM nyc_taxi_zones z WHERE ST_Contains(z.geometry, ST_Point(-73.9859, 40.7276)) ORDER BY z.location_id

question: taxi zones intersecting envelope -74.02,40.68,-73.98,40.70
sql: SELECT z.location_id, z.zone FROM nyc_taxi_zones z WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.68, -73.98, 40.70)) ORDER BY z.location_id

question: taxi zones touching Bath Beach
sql: SELECT b.location_id, b.zone FROM nyc_taxi_zones a JOIN nyc_taxi_zones b ON ST_Touches(a.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE a.zone = 'Bath Beach' ORDER BY b.location_id

question: point -74.0075,40.6043 within which taxi zone
sql: SELECT z.location_id, z.zone FROM nyc_taxi_zones z WHERE ST_Within(ST_Point(-74.0075, 40.6043), z.geometry) ORDER BY z.location_id

question: count trips picked up in zone containing point -73.9943,40.7326
sql: SELECT count(*) AS trip_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.PULocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Contains(z.geometry, ST_Point(-73.9943, 40.7326))

question: average total amount for trips dropped in zones intersecting envelope -73.96,40.78,-73.93,40.80
sql: SELECT avg(t.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON t.DOLocationID = z.location_id WHERE ST_Intersects(z.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.96, 40.78, -73.93, 40.80))
